conventions.signal: sRGB transfer (IEC 61966-2-1) R'G'B' in 0..1; PNG and SDR video carry it
conventions.linear: linear Rec.709 (D65), straight alpha; Bloom's linear working space
conventions.exr: float RGBA, premultiplied, ZIP; values outside 0..1 preserved
conventions.videoSdr: signal -> Y'CbCr by the variant's matrix and range; chroma co-sited horizontally ([1 2 1]/4), 4:2:0 vertical 2-tap average; tags primaries bt709, transfer iec61966-2-1
conventions.videoHdr: linear Rec.709 -> BT.2020, 1.0 = 203 cd/m2; PQ ST 2084 or HLG BT.2100 (1.0 -> 75% signal); negative values clip after the primaries change
conventions.videoCodes: [Y, Cb, Cr] integer codes at the variant's bit depth
conventions.videoAlpha: video without alpha shows the straight colour
conventions.sample: rectangle [x, y, w, h] inset from the patch edges; average it
